_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-36 statistical reality of this coil demands HOLD as the skilled default — no visible breaker (fed_liquidity at 0, dvol at 0, no funding spike) exists to justify a directional claim, and the analyst's own 17.8% direction-accuracy in coiled regimes confirms forcing direction is the failure mode.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call HOLD direction, but split on phase label (Analyst: Disbelief, Narrative: Denial); I anchor to Denial per the score-band rule and weight the analyst's pattern-accuracy self-awareness higher
next_move.confirmed_if: Score stays 32-38 for next 2-3 readings; directional breakout requires funding >0.015% with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d <70 AND cvd_btc_pct_30d >95 (UP), or VIX sustaining >20 with gold >98 and etf_flows <70 (DOWN)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score moves >8 points in a single reading (phase transition to Anxiety or Panic), or fed_liquidity moves >20 points from 0 with directional volume confirmation — either signals the coil broke and HOLD was wrong
